main_indications: Temporary relief of nasal and sinus congestion associated with colds or upper respiratory allergies

refill.summary: This foundation models ordinary nonprescription retail sales; prescription refill analysis is outside this fixture's scope.

masspat.summary: Ordinary nonprescription pseudoephedrine sales are not MassPAT dispensing transactions solely because of CMEA controls.

quantity_limit.summary: Ordinary non-mail-order federal retail limits are 3.6 grams of pseudoephedrine base per day and 9 grams per 30-day period per purchaser.
